question: The uterus opens into the vagina through the ________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Cervix**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **The cervix** is the lower, narrow part of the uterus that connects to the vagina. It acts as a gateway between the uterus and the vagina.
 
• It serves as the passage through which menstrual blood exits the uterus during menstruation and also facilitates the entry of sperm into the uterus during reproduction.
 
• During childbirth, the cervix dilates to allow the baby to pass through the birth canal. *Hence, the cervix is the correct answer.*
